Method of Attack: Privilege escalation via OpenVPN configuration file allowing arbitrary code execution with administrator privileges on Windows
Bypassing parameter checks by placing parameters between quotation marks in OpenVPN config to execute arbitrary code
Attack Vector: Maliciously crafted OpenVPN configuration file with parameters like "script-security", "up", "down" allowing code execution
Modification of OpenVPN config file to include arbitrary code executed with system rights
Indicators of Compromise: OpenVPN configuration files containing dangerous parameters in quotes
